#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an ICS calendar event: Team Meeting, next Wednesday 3-4 PM local time."""
import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

# --- Compute next Wednesday ---
today = date.today()
# weekday(): Monday=0 ... Wednesday=2 ... Sunday=6
days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7  # if today is Wednesday, "next Wednesday" means next week
meeting_date = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

# --- Local timezone ---
local_tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
tzid = getattr(local_tz, "key", None)  # e.g. "America/New_York" for ZoneInfo

start_local = datetime(meeting_date.year, meeting_date.month, meeting_date.day, 15, 0, 0)
end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=1)

# --- Build ICS ---
uid = f"team-meeting-{uuid.uuid4()}@example.com"
dtstamp = datetime.now(ZoneInfo("UTC")).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

if tzid:
    dtstart = f"DTSTART;TZID={tzid}:{start_local.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}"
    dtend = f"DTEND;TZID={tzid}:{end_local.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}"
    start_display = f"{start_local.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p')} ({tzid})"
else:  # fallback: UTC
    start_utc = start_local.astimezone(ZoneInfo("UTC"))
    end_utc = end_local.astimezone(ZoneInfo("UTC"))
    dtstart = f"DTSTART:{start_utc.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}"
    dtend = f"DTEND:{end_utc.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}"
    start_display = f"{start_local.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p')} (local)"

ics_lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
    dtstart,
    dtend,
    "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "BEGIN:VALARM",
    "ACTION:DISPLAY",
    "DESCRIPTION:Reminder: Team Meeting in 15 minutes",
    "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
    "END:VALARM",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]
ics_content = "\r\n".join(ics_lines) + "\r\n"

output_path = "team_meeting.ics"
with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(ics_content)

# --- Validate ---
with open(output_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    raw = f.read()
checks = {
    "starts with BEGIN:VCALENDAR": raw.strip().startswith("BEGIN:VCALENDAR"),
    "ends with END:VCALENDAR": raw.strip().endswith("END:VCALENDAR"),
    "has UID": "UID:" in raw,
    "has DTSTAMP": "DTSTAMP:" in raw,
    "has SUMMARY:Team Meeting": "SUMMARY:Team Meeting" in raw,
    "has DTSTART": "DTSTART" in raw,
    "has DTEND": "DTEND" in raw,
    "has VALARM": "BEGIN:VALARM" in raw and "END:VALARM" in raw,
}
for label, ok in checks.items():
    print(f"[{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}] {label}")

print(f"Event: Team Meeting")
print(f"Date:  {meeting_date.isoformat()}")
print(f"Start: {start_display}")
print(f"End:   {end_local.strftime('%I:%M %p')}")
print(f"File:  {output_path}")
